definitions.explanation: A small, bright particle of burning material thrown off from a fire, or a flash of light produced by electrical discharge or friction.
A figurative spark of conflict or intense competition between people. Used in the expression {火花|ひばな}を{散|ち}らす (to clash fiercely).

examples.japanese: {火花|ひばな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{散|ち}った→散る：02075_chiru⟧。
{溶接|ようせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{火花|ひばな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧レール⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{火花|ひばな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I could see sparks coming from the train's rails.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{火花|ひばな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散|ち}らして→散らす：02288_chirasu⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}した→議論する：06058_gironsuru⟧。
examples.english: The two clashed heatedly in their argument.

⟦{決勝戦|けっしょうせん}→決勝戦：09244_kesshousen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{火花|ひばな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散|ち}らし→散らす：02288_chirasu⟧、⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{沸|わ}かせた→沸く：01122_waku⟧。
examples.english: Both competitors clashed fiercely in the final, thrilling the audience.

notes:
USAGE:
The expression {火花|ひばな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散|ち}らす→散らす：02288_chirasu⟧ literally means "to scatter sparks" and figuratively means "to clash fiercely" or "to compete intensely." This is one of the most common uses of the word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火花|ひばな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{散|ち}る→散る：02075_chiru⟧: sparks fly
- {火花|ひばな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散|ち}らす→散らす：02288_chirasu⟧: to clash fiercely, to compete intensely
- {火花|ひばな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧: sparks fly (literal)
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{火花|ひばな}: electrical spark
